security_audit.summary: The static external-command and reconnaissance findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around Rube and Instagram tool names. The only URL is a documented Rube MCP setup endpoint and does not show hidden network behavior. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or executable code was found in SKILL.md.

3. `INSTAGRAM_GET_POST_STATUS` - Check if the media container is ready [Optional]
- `image_url`: Public URL of the image to post
- `video_url`: Public URL of the video to post

- `metric`: Metrics to retrieve (e.g., impressions, reach, engagement)
- `period`: Time period for insights (e.g., day, week, lifetime)
- The `period` parameter must match the metric type

2. `INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA_CHILDREN` - List children of a carousel post [Optional]
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k

content.user_title: Automate Instagram Publishing with Rube MCP
content.value_statement: Instagram publishing workflows often require precise tool sequences and status checks. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Rube MCP posting, carousel, media, comments, and insights tasks.
actual_capabilities: Guides setup checks for Rube MCP and an active Instagram OAuth connection.
Outlines single image and video post creation with container status checks.
Explains carousel publishing with child media containers and readiness polling.
Shows how to retrieve media, comments, carousel children, and account insights.
Documents publishing limits, required parameters, and common Instagram API pitfalls.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active Instagram Business or Creator account connection.
Personal Instagram accounts are not supported by the documented workflow.
Media URLs must be public HTTPS URLs that remain available during processing.
The skill does not bypass Instagram publishing limits, rate limits, or OAuth requirements.

use_cases.title: Plan a Verified Publishing Flow
use_cases.description: Prepare a single Instagram post with the required media URL, caption, account ID, and readiness checks.

use_cases.title: Publish Multi-Asset Campaign Posts
use_cases.description: Coordinate carousel creation by preparing each media container before publishing the combined post.

use_cases.title: Review Performance and Comments
use_cases.description: Retrieve post details, comments, carousel children, and account insights for reporting workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Verify Instagram Access
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup check before any publishing task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Instagram automation skill to verify Rube MCP access and confirm my Instagram connection is active.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Single Post
prompt_templates.scenario: Create one image or video post from a public media URL.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Instagram automation skill to publish one Instagram post from this public media URL with my caption. Check status before publishing.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Carousel Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Publish several media items as one Instagram carousel.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Instagram automation skill to create a carousel from these public media URLs. Confirm each child container is ready before publishing.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Publishing and Insights
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow that combines quota checks, media retrieval, and reporting.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Instagram automation skill to check publishing limits, list recent media, retrieve insights for a selected post, and summarize issues.

output_examples.input: Post one public product image with a launch caption.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a step plan that verifies account access, creates a media container, waits for readiness, and publishes the caption.

output_examples.input: Publish five campaign images as an Instagram carousel.
output_examples.output: The skill prepares individual media containers, combines them into a carousel container, checks status, and publishes when processing finishes.

output_examples.input: Review engagement for a recent Instagram post.
output_examples.output: The skill guides media lookup, insight selection, and a concise summary of available reach, impression, or engagement metrics.

best_practices: Search Rube tool schemas before each workflow because parameters can change.
Check publishing limits and media container status before publishing posts.
Use stable public HTTPS media URLs and review captions before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not attempt to use personal Instagram accounts with this workflow.
Do not use private, authenticated, or short-lived media URLs for publishing.
Do not use the skill to evade Instagram rate limits or platform policies.

faq.question: Does this skill work with personal Instagram accounts?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow requires an Instagram Business or Creator account connected to a Facebook Page.

faq.question: Does the skill store Instagram credentials?
faq.answer: No evidence was found that the skill stores credentials. Account connection is handled through Rube MCP and Instagram OAuth.

faq.question: Can it publish videos and carousels?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents workflows for single video posts and carousel posts that use public media URLs.

faq.question: Why should the agent search tools first?
faq.answer: Rube tool schemas can change. Searching first helps the agent use current parameter names and requirements.

faq.question: Can this bypass Instagram publishing limits?
faq.answer: No. The skill tells the agent to check limits and follow Instagram publishing and rate limit rules.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code when Rube MCP is available.
